description: Gate expander for Muxlicer, giving one more gate output whose behaviour is set step by step; it goes immediately to the right of a Muxlicer, or to the right of another Mex chained to one

params.text: Picks what the output does on that step: the gate input passed through, silence, or the gate pattern Muxlicer's GATE MODE knob sets

inputs.text: A gate passed through on any step switched to it, squared up if it is not already a gate; with nothing patched here Muxlicer's own clock output is used instead

outputs.text: A 10V gate built step by step from the switch settings, silent while the Muxlicer is stopped

notes: the output stays at 0V unless a Muxlicer is immediately to the left, either next to it or through a chain of other Mex modules, and unless that Muxlicer is playing.

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
